mapper.sql: SELECT a.employee_id, e.employee_code, d.department_code, e.employment_status, a.account_status, a.password_hash, a.credentials_version, a.failed_login_count, a.locked_until FROM employee_account a JOIN employee e ON e.employee_id = a.employee_id JOIN department d ON d.department_id = e.department_id WHERE e.employee_code = #{employeeCode}
mapper.select: SELECT role_code FROM employee_role WHERE employee_id = #{employeeId} AND revoked_at IS NULL
mapper.update: UPDATE employee_account SET password_hash = #{hash}, account_status = 'ACTIVE', credentials_version = credentials_version + 1, session_version = session_version + 1, failed_login_count = 0, locked_until = NULL, activated_at = SYSTIMESTAMP, updated_at = SYSTIMESTAMP WHERE employee_id = #{employeeId} AND account_status = 'PENDING' AND credentials_version = #{expectedVersion}
UPDATE employee_account SET failed_login_count = 0, locked_until = NULL, updated_at = SYSTIMESTAMP WHERE employee_id = #{employeeId}
